capabilities: answer Wedelia's search requests with up to 5 matching excerpts and note paths
open a shared note and send it, capped at 40,000 characters
serve read-only search and fetch tools to allowed AI apps via a remote MCP server
exclude private folders, dot-paths and Wedelia's own mirrored files from search
connect the vault using a connection password from the Wedelia app
disambiguation: Not a note-taking or editing tool; it only lets the Wedelia app (and allowed AI apps) search and read the vault.
extras: Plugin is MIT-licensed but the Wedelia app, API and relay are closed-source. Free accounts are limited to 50 searches a day. The README is candid that sent excerpts and opened notes are visible to the AI model provider handling the request, and it documents search limits: body-only terms in old notes may not be found since only names, headings, tags and aliases are matched before falling back to the 400 most recently modified notes within an 8-second budget. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: AI apps cannot use the notes in a local Obsidian vault, and giving them access usually means uploading the whole vault rather than just what a question needs.

relations.evidence: Lets Wedelia, an AI companion app, search your Obsidian vault while she answers you.
The same plugin also answers AI apps you allow, through a remote MCP server

requires.name: Wedelia app (for the connection password); Claude or ChatGPT for MCP access

summary: Bridge that lets the Wedelia AI companion app search the local vault, returning only matching excerpts or a single opened note.
